styles.title: Demo style documents
styles.documentContent: Use short headings and verifiable facts. Separate findings from planned actions. Never present a hypothesis as a confirmed repair. End with safety checks and approval by an authorized person.

conveyor.title: Preventive — conveyor CV-204
conveyor.description: Draft a report from a fictional preventive work order.
conveyor.fileContent:
FICTIONAL WO — Orion Workshop
Equipment: Conveyor CV-204
Date: 2026-06-18
Reason: Slight drive-side bearing vibration.
Instruction: Inspect after isolation under the site procedure.
conveyor.brief: Write a concise report for the preventive maintenance visit.
conveyor.output:
Conveyor CV-204 — Orion Workshop
Finding: Confirm slight vibration by measurement after isolation.
Follow-up: Check bearing and lubrication against the approved task; record measurements and flag any out-of-range result.
Close-out: An authorized supervisor approves return to service.
